To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SDNp is a hybrid network architecture that establishes centralized control over distributed routing protocols by partitioning the network topology into sub-domain with SDN-enabled nodes.
SDNp allows to trade off control capabilities for network simplicity, and that the optimal sub-domain size is application dependent.

1) SDNp is a new hybrid network control architecture that provides centralized control over distributed routing protocols, 2) it allows to trade-off the dynamic control against the simplicity of the distributed routing protocol OSPF, and 3) it provides a wide range of network control capabilities, from simple traffic engineering to full network virtualization, with a minimum of SDN-enabled network elements.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of hybrid networks that combine the best features of SDN and distributed routing protocols, and that are able to adapt their control plane to the needs of the traffic they carry.
a new hybrid network control paradigm that combines the advantages of SDN and distributed routing protocols.
the question how to achieve a high degree of network programmability while keeping the complexity of network management low.

SDNp is a very interesting and promising concept that can be deployed with very little overhead and provides significant improvements in terms of network control capabilities and performance.
SDNp is a promising new approach to combine SDN and distributed routing protocols.
SDNp is a promising hybrid architecture for future hybrid networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SDNp can provide the best of two control worlds.
SDNp provides an efficient and scalable approach to control distributed routing protocols.
the proposed SDNp approach allows to achieve the best of two control worlds, while maintaining the benefits of distributed routing protocols.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SDNp provides an effective and scalable approach for centralized control over the routing protocol in a hybrid network.
a hybrid SDNp network can provide a wide range of network control capabilities, from the simple operation of a legacy OSPF network to a fully programmable network.
SDN can be deployed in a distributed network in a way that is more flexible and more scalable than the traditional SDN deployment.
